_comment: Player spawn points per map: every individual point the spawn screen can put a fresh survivor at,
from ark.wiki.gg's interactive-map data pages (Data:Maps/Exploration/<map>), fetched 2026-10-24.
Coordinates are in-game COMPASS GPS [lat, lon] - the same lat/lon the in-game map grid shows. Used by the
region-locking design: every 10x10 lat/lon square holding a spawn point starts unlocked.
Island / Center / Fjordur come from the wiki's ASE pages. Scorched / Ragnarok / Valguero only have ASA pages
(same maps, ported); their points were converted ASA GPS -> ASE GPS with the per-map 'asa_to_ase' fit
(ase = a*asa + b per axis), measured on landmarks present on both the ASA and ASE wiki pages.
Ragnarok's ASA page lists only 56 points (12 zones) - thin but zone coverage matches the spawn screen.
WARNING Ragnarok: import_drawn_regions.KNOWN's (13009.4, 49.99) maps world to the MAP IMAGE (0-100), not
the compass. The Ragnarok map image spans compass lon 10-90 / lat 10-87.5 (wiki Data:Regions/Ragnarok
coordinateBorders; matches our obelisk regions), so compass = 10 + 0.8*imgLon, 10 + 0.775*imgLat.
Use the compass transform, not KNOWN, when placing these points in world units on Ragnarok.

asa_to_ase.note: ASA and ASE wiki GPS agree to ~0.01 deg (fit 1.0004/-0.004, 1.0005/-0.033), so identity
only 3 obelisks + 3 veins match (the ASE vein lists differ); amounts to ASA = ASE + ~0.1 deg
